UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings and profile information.

userId.description: The unique ID of the user.

leakedTestHours.description: Hours for the initial Leaked Test.

conditioningProfiles.description: User-defined conditioning profiles for each gel pack model.

role.description: The role of the user within the application.

ConditioningProfile.title: Conditioning Profile
ConditioningProfile.description: Defines the sequence of steps for conditioning a specific gel pack model.

ConditioningStep.title: Conditioning Step
ConditioningStep.description: A single step in a conditioning profile.

chamber.description: The name or type of the chamber for this step.

hours.description: The duration in hours for this step.

GelPack.title: GelPack
GelPack.description: Represents a single gel pack unit used in cold chain logistics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GelPack, derived from the serial number.

serial.description: A formatted, human-readable serial number (e.g., S4 4L 0001).

model.description: The model of the gel pack.

volume.description: The volume of the gel pack in liters.

chamberType.description: The designated temperature chamber for this gel pack model.

status.description: The current status in the gel pack lifecycle.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the gel pack was created.

ownerId.description: The ID of the user who owns/created this gel pack.

ConditioningEvent.title: Conditioning Event
ConditioningEvent.description: Represents a single conditioning cycle for a gel pack.

GTC.title: GTC
GTC.description: Represents a reusable Global Temperature Controlled box.

id.description: Unique ID for the GTC box, derived from its serial.

serial.description: The serial number of the GTC box.

volume.description: The volume capacity of the box in liters.

status.description: The current status of the GTC box.

ownerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this GTC.

Assembly.title: Assembly
Assembly.description: Represents a specific assembly of a GTC box with its corresponding gel packs for a trip.

id.description: Unique identifier for the assembly event.

gtcId.description: The ID of the assembled GTC box.

gtcSerial.description: The serial of the assembled GTC box.

chamberType.description: The required temperature chamber for this assembly.

gelPackIds.description: An array of 6 gel pack IDs included in the assembly.

status.description: The current status of the assembly.

ownerId.description: The ID of the user who performed the assembly.

transitStartTime.description: Timestamp for when the assembly started its transit.

returnTime.description: Timestamp for when the assembly was returned.

params.name: gelPackId
params.description: The unique ID of the gel pack.

params.name: gtcId
params.description: The unique ID of the GTC box.

params.name: assemblyId
params.description: The unique ID of the assembly.

firestore.reasoning: The data structure is updated to support the detailed gel pack management system. User profiles are stored in a top-level collection to manage user-specific settings like conditioning times. The `gelPacks` collection stores all gel pack data, with a denormalized `ownerId` field on each document. This is critical for writing secure, scalable Firestore rules that allow users to only access and modify their own data, avoiding costly and insecure `get()` calls in the rules themselves. The `GelPack` entity now contains all the required fields like model, volume, status, and conditioning history, aligning with the business logic. New entities `GTC` and `Assembly` are added to manage the box assembly process.
